notes:
Bugfixes:

- Prevents Senderstatus checks from hanging indefinitely when Kodi/InputStream Adaptive stalls while opening XLivetv extensionless gateway streams.

- Replaces potentially blocking player-state polling with Player.HasVideo-based startup detection so the configured 5-second start timeout remains effective.

Improvements:

+ Uses asynchronous stop handling for XLivetv, COM and FuckFlix gateway checks so failed stream starts no longer block the remaining channel scan.
